name: 08_presenter_paced_escalation
description: Presenter-paced two-act escalation. Act 1: a backup service account starts enumerating Key Vault secrets at ~10x its baseline rate - queued, and a good moment to hover the FP score for the plain-English explanation and click 'Explain with AI'. The runner then WAITS for Enter. Act 2 (when you say go): the same resource's storage bucket goes public - severity escalates high -> critical and the incident flips to investigating, kicking off the full LLM pipeline live on the dashboard.
expected_outcome: signal 1 alone: 30 (high) + 10 (1 type) + 14 (iam_logs) + 10 (31-vs-3 call-volume anomaly) = 64 -> queued. After Enter, signal 2 correlates: severity escalates to critical, 2 types, best source azure_monitor, public-read anomaly: 40 + 25 + 20 + 10 = 95 -> investigating.

signals.summary: Backup service svc-backup enumerated Key Vault secrets 31 times in one hour — 10× above baseline of 3 calls, indicates credential harvesting or compromised backup account.
External contractor exposed payments vault storage to public internet — follows suspicious backup service enumeration, critical escalation indicating coordinated attack or insider threat.
